crossRefs.note: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name…
“Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive, to the prayer that is made in this…
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant, and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.
translations.bsb: May Your eyes be open to the pleas of Your servant and of Your people Israel, and may You listen to them whenever they call to You.
translations.kjv: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
translations.asv: that thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them whensoever they cry unto thee.
